answer: Give every identity its own task. Each epoch, the network hashes an account's public key with the beacon pulse to pick its topic, required words and numbers, so no two accounts share a prompt. Graders reject answers that ignore those parameters, so no template can bridge puppets: 1,000 accounts mean 1,000 separate inference runs, about $10 per epoch at 1 cent each. With rewards set just above honest cost, a farm's profit horizon is a thin per-puppet margin, never a multiplier.
